identity.name: Unsanctioned SaaS Web Upload of Confidential Financial Records
identity.summary: An adversary or rogue insider uploads confidential financial spreadsheets containing tax IDs, revenue numbers, and PII to an external unmanaged web service.
identity.description: Exfiltration over HTTPS to unsanctioned cloud services bypasses traditional perimeter port filters. Palo Alto Networks Enterprise DLP and Prisma Browser inspect outbound multipart HTTP/S uploads, applying machine learning and regex classifiers to detect confidential corporate spreadsheets.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage

prerequisites.description: Enterprise DLP inspection enabled on network egress path.

biocs.name: Financial Data Staging
biocs.logic: preset = xdr_data | filter event_type = 'FILE_WRITE' and action_file_name contains 'financials' and (action_file_path contains '/tmp/' or action_file_path contains 'AppData')

biocs.name: DLP Unsanctioned Web Upload
biocs.logic: preset = xdr_data | filter event_type = 'NETWORK' and action_process_image_name in ('curl', 'powershell', 'chrome', 'msedge') and action_process_command_line contains 'financials.csv'

xql_queries.name: Enterprise DLP Cloud Upload Audit
xql_queries.query: dataset = panw_dlp_raw | filter dlp_status in ('BLOCKED', 'ALERT') and file_type in ('CSV', 'XLSX') | comp count() as violations by user_id, destination_domain | filter violations >= 1

correlation_rules.name: Financial File Staged Followed by Multipart Upload
correlation_rules.logic: Sequence: File Write (Financial CSV) -> Network Upload within 180s

products.evidence_query: dataset = xdr_data | filter dst_action_external_hostname contains 'httpbin' or action_process_command_line contains 'financials'

references.title: Unit 42 - Cloud Threat Report: Sensitive Data Security
